statusHistory.note: Operator direct tip via Instagram (@drina_restaurante, ~20k followers) -> trust: auto per rules.md trust-gate. Open since 1967 on Rua Oswaldo Cochrane, Embaré, pay-by-weight home-cooking buffet built around the house's own vegetable garden. Arabic specialties Fri/Sun, feijoada Wed/Sat, roasted goat and apple strudel confirmed via mindtrip.ai, Tripadvisor and Turismo Santos, cross-referenced with the venue's own Instagram feed for texture. Tripadvisor 4.6/5 across a real review base. No dated events found in the Instagram feed (product/food posts only) -- none invented or nested. Distinct register from made-cozinha-autoral-santos (tasting menu) and cafe-carioca-santos (standing pastel counter) -- sit-down pay-by-weight lunch house, Embaré neighborhood, ~1.5-4km from every other Santos food-drink pin, no duplication risk. Coordinates geocoded via OpenStreetMap Nominatim against the street address (moderate confidence -- street-level match, not a verified venue pin) rather than a live Google Maps listing check, given session token constraints; flagged for a future confidence upgrade. Image sourced from the venue's public Tripadvisor listing per explicit operator instruction to prioritize Tripadvisor/official channels over an extended illustrator search this session.
